claims.claim: C1: frequency-separated HRL can share one training core
claims.evidence: Shared dual PPO loop drives Trading and Transit surrogate adapters, and a native Transit episode loop now uses the same PPO core for upper/lower actions.
claims.metric: trading plan return=0.2991; transit composite=1.6950337432937435; native bridge=supported_interface U=20x4 L=43x1; native loop=supported_native_episode_loop, wait=6.9890; offpolicy native=supported_native_episode_loop, replay_updates=3
claims.remaining_gap: Native shared-PPO episode loop exists; multi-seed native performance validation remains.

claims.claim: C2: high-level plan variables can be learned as curves
claims.evidence: Upper PPO action can parameterize Bernstein coefficients.
claims.remaining_gap: Public-data and copied-Transit learned plan-coefficient training remain open.

claims.claim: C3: promotion should trigger replanning after persistent shocks
claims.evidence: Deterministic replan improves trading recovery, a learned PPO promotion gate improves Transit surrogate reward/wait, and native Transit promotion-replan increases timetable replans.
claims.metric: return delta=0.0014, recovery regret delta=-0.0007; learned transit reward=+0.0047 [+0.0016, +0.0076], wait=-0.0079 [-0.0096, -0.0062], replans=+20.1000 [+14.9000, +25.5000]; native reward=+0.0168 [-11.2749, +16.2435], native replans=+49.4167 [+36.4146, +62.0000]; native learned reward=+3.6935 [-12.3283, +17.8474], native learned score=-0.0068 [-0.0904, +0.0555], native learned gate replans=+1.5000 [+1.0813, +1.9167]; native learned reward NI=supported, wait NI=supported
claims.remaining_gap: Native learned gate now preserves the closed native action policy and has CI-supported gate replans plus bounded reward/wait noninferiority; episode reward/wait improvement CIs remain inconclusive, so larger off-policy/native training remains.

claims.claim: C4: leakage can be constrained at loss level
claims.evidence: PPO trajectory constraints with primal-dual multiplier reduce lower-LF drift.
claims.remaining_gap: Projected and raw lower-drift constraints are supported in surrogate diagnostics; native and real-data confirmation remain.

claims.claim: C5: advanced causal encoders can be swapped by domain
claims.evidence: Adaptive lifting wavelet and neural/PINN state-space encoders run in Trading and Transit trackers and ablations.
claims.metric: adaptive Sharpe=13.0749; neural Sharpe=6.8422; EMA Sharpe=16.0625
claims.remaining_gap: Neural/PINN encoder path exists; larger cross-domain performance validation is still needed.

claims.claim: C6: public-data validation covers more than daily bars
claims.evidence: Yahoo 5-minute SPY/QQQ/IWM encoder ablation, order-book microstructure CSV adapter artifacts, multi-seed spread/depth/latency stress checks, and an L2 market/passive-queue matching simulator with CSV input support.
claims.metric: best intraday encoder=adaptive_wavelet, Sharpe=-9.2200; best order-book encoder=state_space, Sharpe=299.9851; best stress encoder=adaptive_wavelet under stale_book, Sharpe=243.4833; stress adaptive Sharpe=+0.2807 [-0.3942, +0.9004]; best L2 matching encoder=state_space mode=market latency=0, Sharpe=599.2800; L2 adaptive Sharpe=+1.4779 [-1.3087, +3.8865]
claims.remaining_gap: Order-book adapter, stress matrix, and L2 queue-priority matching proxy exist; larger real L2/L3 feeds and full exchange event replay remain for the strongest data claim.

claims.claim: C7: integrated native Transit Freq-HRL closes the copied-runner gap
claims.evidence: Gap-closure matrix combines count demand state, plan curves, promotion replanning, native lower context, wait credit, and drift constraint; native loop runs the same shared PPO core inside the copied Transit simulator.
claims.remaining_gap: Supported on surrogate performance plus a native shared-PPO episode loop and native AFC/APC-profile passenger generation; exact AFC/APC OD geometry and alighting-throughput support remain open.

claims.claim: C8: passenger waiting-time frequency credit improves control quality
claims.evidence: Full Freq-HRL path is paired against the same path without wait attribution in both the surrogate gate and the native shared-PPO Transit loop; real AFC/APC demand traces are replayed through the shared PPO control loop.
claims.metric: surrogate wait delta=-0.1251 [-0.1468, -0.1020]; native final wait delta=-8.5908 [-20.4276, -0.9074]; native score delta=+8.6724 [+1.0542, +20.4807]; native reward delta=+2037.3278 [-66.8598, +6165.1210]; real-demand objective delta=+1.8114 [+1.2826, +2.4539]; real-demand wait delta=-1.6741 [-2.2818, -1.1728]; native real-demand wait delta=-0.0830 [-0.2248, +0.0567]; native wait noninferiority=supported
claims.remaining_gap: Native wait-credit path is supported in the shared-PPO loop; native real-demand passenger loop has score/reward support and bounded wait noninferiority, but wait-improvement CI and exact AFC/APC OD validation remain open.

claims.claim: C9: leakage constraints achieve no-tradeoff responsibility separation
claims.evidence: Trading and Transit primal-dual constraints are checked on paired seeds for drift and task-return deltas.
claims.metric: trading drift=supported, trading return=supported, transit drift=supported, transit reward=supported; raw drift trading=supported, raw drift transit=supported
claims.remaining_gap: Supported on surrogate Trading/Transit with raw-drift diagnostics; still needs native Transit and real-data confirmation.

claims.claim: C10: causal count-state demand estimators support Transit demand validation
claims.evidence: Poisson/NB harmonic estimator is paired against Fourier by seed/source across synthetic/copy/GTFS traces; real MTA AFC station-hour ridership and Halifax APC route boardings include causal calibrated profile baselines and shared-PPO control replay.
claims.metric: all-demand MSE delta=+4202.4659 [+1172.4726, +8434.5613]; AFC NB MSE delta=+16121.7347 [+6009.5751, +31280.0939]; AFC profile MSE delta=-7186235.1828 [-10935870.1938, -4496470.4747]; APC profile MSE delta=-5034.9993 [-8843.9598, -2369.0635]; real-control objective delta=+1.8114 [+1.2826, +2.4539]; native real-control score delta=+99.6725 [+62.3044, +137.0299]; native board-wait delta=-0.0833 [-0.2251, +0.0564]; native alighted delta=-4.8333 [-9.8333, -0.8333]; alighted noninferiority=supported
claims.remaining_gap: Real AFC/APC profiles now drive native passenger generation with boarding/alighting/onboard-load metrics; score is supported, board-wait is positive_mixed, wait noninferiority is supported, alighted improvement is not_supported, alighted noninferiority is supported, and exact public OD/onboard occupancy feeds remain open.
